SHIFT NOTES — Electrical Documentation Backlog at
the Late Desk
Date: 2026-10-17
Station: DEMO-STATION-02
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
15:35 — Late-desk note from PERSON-0022 for TEAM-0004: use the
electrical paperwork folder for the documentation backlog
discussion. ISSUE-0063 and TASK-0166 locate the material to be
discussed with the documentation team's coordinator. This desk
is collecting filing questions, not taking over that team's
assignments.
16:10 — Sort requests by the missing attachment heading:
source note, dated cover sheet, or destination index. Put the
expected heading on a request even when the attachment itself
cannot be found. A vague request for more detail usually sends
the records clerk back to the same shelf.
17:45 — Ask the documentation coordinator to give each paper
request a collecting role and a promised filing date. Keep
requests for TASK-0164 and TASK-0165 in their own task
reference spaces if they arise during the discussion. Do not
combine differently scoped papers under a shortened subject
heading.
19:20 — Send the filing list to the incoming desk. The list
uses attachment heading, collecting role, and promised date as
its columns. Leave room beneath each request for the incoming
clerk to record where the paper was eventually filed.
Next-shift list
~ Compare the filing list with the electrical folder index.
